summary.headline: Jupiter’s Planetary Aspects
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of Jupiter in trine, square, and opposition to Mars, the Sun, and Venus, concerning authority, livelihood, family possessions, children, friends, wealth, marriage, and social advancement. The apparatus cross-references parallel passages in Firmicus manuscripts and records variant readings.
